newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Penn sees "mixed year" in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Penn sees "mixed year" in 1997.

text.p: National Penn Bancshares Inc's president, Lawrence Jilk Jr, said Tuesday he anticipates a mixed year for the company in 1997, with efforts started in 1996 beginning to pay off.
At the company's annual shareholders meeting, Jilk also said he expected the bank holding company's 1997 earnings to be "well in line with our historic performance.

National Penn reported a net income of $16.922 million for 1996, up 10 percent from a year ago. For the first quarter of 1997, it reported a net income of $4.534 million, up 10.2 percent from the quarter a year ago.
